name: @axonllm/blueprint
description: Bedrock-powered infrastructure design, IaC generation, configuration review, and troubleshooting.

scripts.setup: npm --prefix backend ci && npm --prefix frontend ci
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.audit:dependencies: npm --prefix backend audit --audit-level=high && npm --prefix frontend audit --audit-level=high
scripts.audit:signatures: npm --prefix backend audit signatures && npm --prefix frontend audit signatures
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.verify: npm run secret:scan && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
